comment: A Spark's host checks as both clients show them: the Controller web Spark page and `vonkctl fleet detail`. The Controller owns every word (finding, explanation, commands); each client shows the finding and its explanation as one line, then each command on its own line, in order. The web test calls `hostCheckLines` and the vonkctl test calls `host_check_lines` for each case; both must equal `lines` exactly.

commands: sudo systemctl disable --now snapd.service snapd.socket snapd.seeded.service snapd.snap-repair.timer

advice.explanation: After memory fragments, the kernel raises its free-memory watermarks by this factor and reclaims ahead of need; that memory is missing from MemAvailable while the boost lasts. 0 turns the boost off, now and at every boot.

lines: vm.watermark_boost_factor is 15000. After memory fragments, the kernel raises its free-memory watermarks by this factor and reclaims ahead of need; that memory is missing from MemAvailable while the boost lasts. 0 turns the boost off, now and at every boot.

advice.finding: 78.7 GiB of 116.7 GiB free is in blocks of 2 MiB or more (67%).
advice.explanation: The GPU driver takes unified memory in physically contiguous blocks of 2 MiB or more, so a load can run short while smaller free blocks remain. Compaction regroups free memory; run it while no workload is loading.
commands: sync; echo 1 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches; echo 1 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory
